name: uniform permutation by swaps
mechanism: walk the sequence from the end, swapping each position with a uniformly random position at or before it, so every permutation is equally likely in one pass

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Fisher–Yates shuffle (also known as the Knuth shuffle)' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Sequence permutations: randomly shuffle a finite set
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Bogosort': the list is randomly shuffled until it happens to be sorted

fails_when: a biased or naive swap range makes some permutations more likely
instances: Fisher–Yates shuffle (also known as the Knuth shuffle)
